answer: One proof is cheap, a hundred are a business that loses money by existing; the nectar is the point where cloning stops paying. A single clone pays a separate reference check for every name, at about £60 a proof, and the tundra is that the payout per clone never grows to meet it. The gate does not care who runs the farm, only how many names it brings. Start with the person, not the account: Confirmed industrial cleaner licence with industrial cleaners confirmation requires a licence cleaners renew after site audits, so the reef is a real human behind every name.
